title.narrative: EU PRO Plus: Supporting local development in Serbia

description.narrative: UNOPS will implement the €30 million, European Union-funded programme with Serbia's Ministry of European Integration. The three-year EU PRO Plus will encourage integrated social and economic development in 99 local self-governments in western, southern and eastern Serbia. The programme will focus on improving social infrastructure and social cohesion, as well as on improving business infrastructure and encouraging entrepreneurship – including among women, young people and people in vulnerable groups and the creation of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises.
